title: Happy zebra
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='28' ry='20' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <!-- stripes on body -->
  <path d='M32 50 Q40 62 34 78' stroke='#3a2a6e' stroke-width='4' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M42 44 Q48 62 42 82' stroke='#3a2a6e' stroke-width='4' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M52 44 Q58 62 52 82' stroke='#3a2a6e' stroke-width='4' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M62 46 Q68 60 64 78' stroke='#3a2a6e' stroke-width='4' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M72 52 Q76 62 73 72' stroke='#3a2a6e' stroke-width='4' fill='none'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='76' width='8' height='16' rx='3' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <rect x='40' y='78' width='8' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <rect x='56' y='78' width='8' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <rect x='68' y='76' width='8' height='16' rx='3' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <!-- leg stripes -->
  <rect x='28' y='82' width='8' height='3' fill='#3a2a6e'/>
  <rect x='40' y='84' width='8' height='3' fill='#3a2a6e'/>
  <rect x='56' y='84' width='8' height='3' fill='#3a2a6e'/>
  <rect x='68' y='82' width='8' height='3' fill='#3a2a6e'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='28' y='90' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a2a6e'/>
  <rect x='40' y='90' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a2a6e'/>
  <rect x='56' y='90' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a2a6e'/>
  <rect x='68' y='90' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a2a6e'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M22 58 Q16 42 22 28 L34 30 Q30 42 34 56 Z' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <!-- neck stripes -->
  <path d='M22 50 Q26 48 30 50' stroke='#3a2a6e' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M22 42 Q26 40 30 42' stroke='#3a2a6e' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M23 34 Q27 32 31 34' stroke='#3a2a6e' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='24' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='12' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#f5f0e0' transform='rotate(-20 20 12)'/>
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='12' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#e88bb4' transform='rotate(-20 20 12)'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='12' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#f5f0e0' transform='rotate(20 34 12)'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='12' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#e88bb4' transform='rotate(20 34 12)'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M16 16 Q14 22 18 28 Q13 30 17 36' stroke='#3a2a6e' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M14 18 Q12 24 15 30' stroke='#3a2a6e' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='18' cy='30' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#f8b8d0'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='15' cy='29' r='1.2' fill='#3a2a6e'/>
  <circle cx='19' cy='29' r='1.2' fill='#3a2a6e'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M14 32 Q18 36 22 32' stroke='#3a2a6e' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='21' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='21' r='2' fill='#3a2a6e'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='20' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='21' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='21' r='2' fill='#3a2a6e'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='20' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='27' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#f8a0b8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M78 55 Q88 50 86 42' stroke='#f5f0e0' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='40' r='4' fill='#3a2a6e'/>
  <!-- smile detail on body -->
  <path d='M30 34 Q35 38 40 34' stroke='#e88bb4' stroke-width='1' fill='none' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
